title: Dinner in San Jose with a female crash retrieval program worker
summary: Eric Davis tells of Dinner in San Jose with a female crash retrieval program worker, about 1970s-1980s program; meeting later at San Jose, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh, yeah. It was a woman. I met her. I we he my source, his wife, uh took me to her home, picked her up. We went into San Jose to have dinner at a German restaurant.

plain: The physicist Eric Davis told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he once met a woman who, he says, had worked in a secret program in the 1970s and 1980s recovering crashed craft that were not made by humans. Davis says his source's wife drove him to the woman's home, picked her up, and the three of them went to a German restaurant in San Jose, California, for dinner. If true, it would mean he spoke face to face with someone who handled such material.
